settings.title: Earth Preferences
settings.general.accessibility_hint: If enabled in System Settings but still showing unauthorized after an upgrade, select Earth in Accessibility, remove it with '-', and add it back.
settings.general.shortcuts_title: Shortcuts (click a box and press your new key combo)
settings.general.shortcut_needs_mod: Please include a modifier key such as Ctrl / Alt / Shift
settings.general.click_hint_double: Single-click opens the Workbench preview; double-click copies or pastes.
settings.general.click_hint_single: Single-click copies/pastes directly while Workbench is closed. When Workbench is open, clicking another item switches preview and clicking the selected item copies it.
settings.general.auto_paste: Auto-paste to previous app after selection
settings.general.plain_text_paste: Paste as plain text by default (strip rich formatting)
settings.general.paste_hint_macos:
• Hold ⌥ + Click/Enter: Copy only
• Hold ⌘ + Click/Enter: Copy & paste immediately
• Hold ⇧⌘ + Click/Enter: Copy & paste as plain text
settings.general.paste_hint_other:
• Hold Alt + Click/Enter: Copy only
• Click/Enter (or Ctrl+Enter): Copy & paste using default behavior
• Hold Ctrl+Shift + Click/Enter: Copy & paste as plain text
settings.storage.save_types_hint: Only checked types are recorded (pinned items and collection items are never auto-pruned).
settings.storage.backup_note: Local history and backups are unencrypted; masking only affects display. New JSON backups embed images (up to 64 MiB per image, 128 MiB per backup).
settings.appearance.show_tray: Show menu bar / system tray icon
settings.appearance.menubar_preview: Show latest clipboard text in menu bar / tray tooltip
settings.ignore.privacy_mask: Auto-mask sensitive secrets (API Key / JWT / Bearer Token / Private Key)
settings.ignore.privacy_hint: Suspected secrets are masked with •••• in the list; click "Reveal" in the Workbench to view.
settings.ignore.whitelist_mode: Allowlist mode: ignore all apps outside this list
settings.ignore.app_placeholder: App name, Bundle ID, or process (e.g. 1Password, WeChat.exe)
settings.ignore.types_hint: Exact format match. text, html, rtf, image, files skip only that representation; privacy markers and custom formats skip the entire copy.
settings.ignore.regex_hint: Copied text matching any regular expression below will not be recorded:
settings.advanced.clear_on_exit: Clear unpinned history when quitting Earth
settings.advanced.clear_system: Also clear system clipboard when clearing history
settings.advanced.collections_hint: Save frequent commands, snippets, or assets into collections so they are never auto-pruned.
